features.name: Divine Sense
features.summary: Action: until the end of your next turn, learn the location and type (celestial, fiend, undead) of such creatures within 60 ft. not behind total cover, plus consecrated/desecrated places or objects.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.summary: Healing pool of 5 x paladin level HP. Action, touch: restore any amount of HP from the pool, or spend 5 points per disease cured / poison neutralized. No effect on undead or constructs.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.summary: Pick one fighting style from the paladin list (Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection). The same style can never be taken twice.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Half-caster using Charisma. Prepare CHA mod + half paladin level (round down, min 1) spells from the paladin list after a long rest; slots per the class table. Holy symbol can be a focus.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.summary: On a melee weapon hit, spend a paladin spell slot for extra radiant damage: 2d8 for 1st level, +1d8 per slot level above 1st (max 5d8), +1d8 more vs. undead or fiends.

features.name: Divine Health
features.summary: You are immune to disease.

features.name: Sacred Oath
features.summary: Swear an oath (Devotion, Ancients, or Vengeance). It grants features at 3rd, 7th, 15th, and 20th level, including oath spells and Channel Divinity options.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.summary: Part of Sacred Oath. Each oath lists spells gained at paladin levels 3/5/9/13/17; they are always prepared, don't count against your prepared total, and count as paladin spells.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.summary: Part of Sacred Oath. Use one Channel Divinity option granted by your oath; then you must finish a short or long rest before using it again. Save DC = your paladin spell save DC.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level: +2 to one ability score or +1 to two, max 20.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.summary: When you take the Attack action, you make two attacks instead of one.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.summary: While you are conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 ft. add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to all saving throws. Range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.summary: While you are conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 ft. can't be frightened. Range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

features.name: Improved Divine Smite
features.summary: Every melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage; this stacks with Divine Smite.

features.name: Cleansing Touch
features.summary: Action: end one spell on yourself or on a willing creature you touch.

features.name: Aura improvements
features.summary: Your paladin auras (Aura of Protection, Aura of Courage, and your oath's 7th-level aura) extend from 10 ft. to 30 ft.

choices.name: Dueling
choices.summary: +2 damage with a melee weapon held in one hand when you hold no other weapon.

choices.name: Great Weapon Fighting
choices.summary: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice for two-handed melee weapon attacks (weapon must be two-handed or versatile); must keep the new roll.

choices.name: Protection
choices.summary: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against a creature (not you) within 5 ft. of you that you can see. Requires a shield.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared Oath of Devotion spells (see spells).

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.summary: Channel Divinity, action: for 1 minute a held weapon adds your CHA mod (min +1) to attack rolls, sheds bright light 20 ft. (dim 20 ft. more), and counts as magical. Ends if dropped or you fall unconscious.

features.name: Turn the Unholy
features.summary: Channel Divinity, action: each fiend or undead within 30 ft. that can see or hear you makes a WIS save or is turned for 1 minute or until damaged (must flee, no reactions, only Dash/escape/Dodge).

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.summary: While you are conscious, you and friendly creatures within 10 ft. can't be charmed. Range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.summary: You are permanently under the effect of protection from evil and good.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.summary: Action: for 1 minute emit bright sunlight 30 ft. (dim 30 ft. more); enemies starting their turn in the bright light take 10 radiant damage; you have advantage on saves vs. spells cast by fiends or undead.

choices.name: Sacred Weapon
choices.summary: Empower a held weapon: +CHA to attacks, light, magical, 1 minute.

choices.name: Turn the Unholy
choices.summary: Turn fiends and undead within 30 ft. on a failed WIS save.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared Oath of the Ancients spells (see spells).

features.name: Nature's Wrath
features.summary: Channel Divinity, action: spectral vines attack a creature within 10 ft. that you can see; it makes a STR or DEX save (its choice) or is restrained, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

features.name: Turn the Faithless
features.summary: Channel Divinity, action: each fey or fiend within 30 ft. that can hear you makes a WIS save or is turned for 1 minute or until damaged; a turned creature's disguised true form is revealed.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.summary: You and friendly creatures within 10 ft. have resistance to damage from spells. Range becomes 30 ft. at 18th level.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.summary: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 HP instead. You also suffer no drawbacks of old age and can't be magically aged.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.summary: Action: transform for 1 minute. Regain 10 HP at the start of each of your turns, cast 1-action paladin spells as a bonus action, and enemies within 10 ft. have disadvantage on saves vs. your paladin spells and Channel Divinity.

choices.name: Nature's Wrath
choices.summary: Restrain one creature within 10 ft. with spectral vines (STR or DEX save).

choices.name: Turn the Faithless
choices.summary: Turn fey and fiends within 30 ft. on a failed WIS save.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.summary: Always-prepared Oath of Vengeance spells (see spells).

features.name: Abjure Enemy
features.summary: Channel Divinity, action: one creature within 60 ft. you can see makes a WIS save (fiends/undead at disadvantage; frighten-immune creatures unaffected). Fail: frightened 1 minute or until damaged, speed 0. Success: speed halved 1 minute or until damaged.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.summary: Channel Divinity, bonus action: choose a creature within 10 ft. you can see; you have advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 HP or falls unconscious.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.summary: When you hit with an opportunity attack, you may move up to half your speed as part of that reaction, without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.summary: When the target of your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it if it is in range.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.summary: Action: transform for 1 hour. Gain a 60 ft. flying speed and a 30 ft. aura; enemies entering or starting a turn there for the first time make a WIS save or are frightened 1 minute or until damaged, and attacks against them have advantage.

choices.name: Abjure Enemy
choices.summary: Frighten and root one creature within 60 ft. (WIS save).

choices.name: Vow of Enmity
choices.summary: Advantage on attacks vs. one creature within 10 ft. for 1 minute.

discrepancies: NO LIMITED-USE RESOURCES: no feature object in classes.json has any resource/uses field (features only have name, level, desc), so Lay on Hands (5 x level HP pool, long rest), Divine Sense (1 + CHA mod, long rest), Channel Divinity (1 use, short or long rest), Cleansing Touch (max(1, CHA mod), long rest) and the once-per-long-rest capstones (Holy Nimbus, Elder Champion, Avenging Angel) plus Undying Sentinel cannot be tracked. This is the likely cause of Lay on Hands 'not being usable'.

Oath of the Ancients (id 'ancients') has NO features in the app: missing Oath Spells, Nature's Wrath and Turn the Faithless (3rd), Aura of Warding (7th), Undying Sentinel (15th), Elder Champion (20th).
Oath of Vengeance (id 'vengeance') has NO features in the app: missing Oath Spells, Abjure Enemy and Vow of Enmity (3rd), Relentless Avenger (7th), Soul of Vengeance (15th), Avenging Angel (20th).
No oath spell lists anywhere in the app data for any oath (Devotion, Ancients, Vengeance); the PHB grants always-prepared spells at paladin levels 3/5/9/13/17 (see spells in this file).
Fighting Style has no option list in the app (the desc ends at 'Choose one of the following options'); PHB paladin options are Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection.

Devotion: the app names the Channel Divinity options 'Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon' / 'Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy'; the book names them 'Sacred Weapon' and 'Turn the Unholy' (options of the Channel Divinity feature). Devotion also lacks an Oath Spells entry, and Holy Nimbus' app desc omits that it is usable once per long rest.

Class table level 3: app progression lists 'Divine Health', 'Sacred Oath', 'Oath Spells', 'Channel Divinity'; the book's table lists only 'Divine Health, Sacred Oath' (Oath Spells and Channel Divinity are sub-sections of Sacred Oath). Harmless but differs from the book.

App feature 'Spellcasting: Paladin' is printed as 'Spellcasting' in the book; app desc only has the first flavor sentence (no preparation formula CHA mod + half paladin level, no spell save DC/attack formulas, no holy-symbol focus).
App 'Sacred Oath feature' entries at 7/15/20 reuse the 3rd-level Sacred Oath description text instead of being pure placeholders (and the 3rd-level 'Sacred Oath' entry is fine).
Divine Smite app desc says 'expend one spell slot'; the printed PHB says 'one paladin spell slot' (SRD wording). Minor.
Proficiencies: app lumps armor as 'All armor' rather than Light/Medium/Heavy Armor + Shields; equivalent but not split like other classes.

Matches the book: hit die d10, saves WIS/CHA, skill choice (2 of Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, Religion), spell ability CHA, subclass level 3, proficiency bonus column, and all spell slot numbers for levels 1-20; aura_range 10 at 6th and 30 at 18th is correct.
